app_launched.why: Count how often the app opens each day.

play_opened.why: Guide work on the Plays screen without an exact play count.

surface_shown.why: See which parts of the app get used and which need work.

pdf_exported.why: Decide which exports and built-in formats to improve.

format_saved.why: Know whether writers make their own formats.

update_installed.why: Check whether updates arrive and how far behind copies fall.

error_shown.why: Fix the errors writers actually meet without collecting error messages.

meanings.E-BOOT: The app could not start, and said so on screen.
meanings.E-FOLDER-OPEN: A Plays folder could not be opened.
meanings.E-FOLDER-REFUSED: A folder the app will not keep plays in: a play, inside a play, or kept by two sync services.
meanings.E-FOLDER-ACCESS: A folder grant could not be renewed or saved for the next launch.
meanings.E-PLAY-OPEN: A play could not be opened.
meanings.E-PLAY-NO-SCRIPT: A play opened with no script in it to show.
meanings.E-PLAY-DETAILS: A play's details changed on disk and could not be read, so it opened read-only.
meanings.E-PLAY-SETTINGS: A play's status, logline or format could not be changed.
meanings.E-PLAY-TRASH: A play could not be moved to the Trash.
meanings.E-IMPORT-OPEN: An import made its new play, but the play could not be opened.
meanings.E-SCRIPT-OPEN: A script in an open play could not be read.
meanings.E-PLAY-MISSING: A play is not in the Plays folder any more.
meanings.E-PLAY-CREATE: A new play could not be made.
meanings.E-SAVE-LOCKED: Words could not be saved: the file, or its folder, is locked in Finder.
meanings.E-SAVE-PERMISSION: Words could not be saved: the Mac's user may not change the folder.
meanings.E-SAVE-NOT-ALLOWED: Words could not be saved: macOS refused, as it does for a view-only shared folder, a privacy setting or the sandbox.
meanings.E-SAVE-DISK-FULL: Words could not be saved: the disk is full.
meanings.E-SAVE-READ-ONLY: Words could not be saved: the disk is read-only.
meanings.E-SAVE-FOLDER-GONE: Words could not be saved: the play's folder is not there.
meanings.E-SAVE-UNREACHABLE: Words could not be saved: the disk or network drive did not respond.
meanings.E-CHANGED-ON-DISK: A file changed on disk underneath an edit.
meanings.E-VERSIONS: Versions could not keep or read a version.
meanings.E-BINDER: A change to the binder could not be made.
meanings.E-ACTION-STALE: An action arrived after the script or play it was for had closed, so nothing changed.
meanings.E-VAULT-READ: A file could not be read or found.
meanings.E-VAULT-PERMISSION: macOS refused access to a file or folder.
meanings.E-EXPORT-PDF: A PDF could not be exported.
meanings.E-EXPORT-FONT: The fonts a PDF embeds could not be loaded.
meanings.E-PRINT: A script could not be printed.
meanings.E-FORMAT-READ: A format file could not be read.
meanings.E-FORMAT-IMPORT: A format could not be imported.
meanings.E-FORMAT-EXPORT: A format could not be exported.
meanings.E-FORMAT-SAVE: A format could not be saved.
meanings.E-FORMAT-TRASH: A format could not be moved to the Trash, or put back.
meanings.E-FORMATS-FOLDER: The Formats folder could not be opened.
meanings.E-REVEAL: Finder could not show a folder.
meanings.E-FINDER-OPEN: Something opened from Finder could not be opened.
meanings.E-UPDATE-RESTART: An update could not restart the app.
meanings.E-WATCH: The play folder could not be watched for changes made outside.
meanings.E-PRACTICE: A practice, or its kept copy, could not be opened, kept or stopped.
meanings.E-WORKSPACE: Any other error while working in a play.
meanings.E-OTHER: An error the app showed without a code of its own.

copy_active.why: Count how many copies are in use each day, week and month, and how many are new, without anything that tells one copy from another.

tutorial_offered.why: See whether writers take the guided start when it is offered.

lesson_progress.why: See which lessons writers start, come back to and finish.

lesson_stopped.why: See which step of a lesson writers leave at, so that step can be made clearer.
